## Overview

This module converts program-level graduate projections into occupation-level NLS (New Labour Supply) and occupation counts using labour-supply and occupation-distribution inputs. It produces final NLS distributions by age group, credential, region, and year for downstream labour-market modelling and quality-indicator reruns.

## Key Inputs

## Data Dictionary — Key Inputs

### graduate_projections: projected graduates by PSSM_CRED, AGE_GROUP, YEAR

<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>PSSM_CREDENTIAL (String): High-level credential label (e.g., "CERT", "DIPL", "BACH").</li>
  <li>PSSM_CRED (String): Detailed credential code used for joins (e.g., "1 - CERT", "P - DIPL").</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP (String): Fine-grained age group label (e.g., "20-24").</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP (String): Aggregated age-group label used for joins (e.g., "20-24;25-29").</li>
  <li>YEAR (Integer): Projection year (YYYY).</li>
  <li>GRADUATES (Numeric): Projected graduates count for the cell.</li>
  <li>GRAD_STATUS (String, optional): Graduation status or cohort qualifier.</li>
</ul>

### cohort_program_distributions: program-to-cohort allocation (PERCENT)
<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>PSSM_CREDENTIAL / PSSM_CRED (String): Keys matching graduate_projections.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP / AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP (String): Age grouping keys for allocation.</li>
  <li>YEAR (Integer): Year that the distribution applies to.</li>
  <li>LCP4_CD (String): 4-digit LCP program code used for mapping to LCIP/occupation tables.</li>
  <li>LCIP4_CRED (String): Join key encoding (e.g., "1 - 1234 - CERT").</li>
  <li>PERCENT (Numeric): Fraction of the credential cohort allocated to this program cell (0-1).</li>
  <li>Other metadata (e.g., GRAD_STATUS, TTRAIN) used by downstream filters.</li>
</ul>

### labour_supply_distribution (and _no_tt variants): labour-supply shares by LCIP4/LCIP2, age, region
<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>LCIP4_CRED (String): Program-level key matching cohort_program_distributions (includes trades flag when present).</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP (String): Age rollup used for joining.</li>
  <li>CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE_ROLLUP (String): Region rollup code for geographic allocation.</li>
  <li>NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY (Numeric): Labour-supply share for the cell (0-1) used to compute NLS.</li>
  <li>PSSM_CRED (String, optional): Credential label in some distribution tables (e.g., "P - CERT").</li>
</ul>

### labour_supply_distribution_lcp2* (LCIP2 proxies): labour-supply shares by LCIP4/LCIP2, age, region
<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>LCIP2_CRED or LCP2_CD (String): 2-digit CIP code or encoded join key.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP (String): Age rollup key.</li>
  <li>CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE_ROLLUP (String): Region rollup.</li>
  <li>NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY (Numeric): Labour-supply share at the 2-digit proxy level.</li>
</ul>

### occupation_distributions (and lcp2 variants): occupation probabilities (PERCENT) by program and age
<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>LCIP4_CRED or LCIP2_CRED (String): Program-level join key (4- or 2-digit proxy).</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP (String): Age rollup for occupation probabilities.</li>
  <li>CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE_ROLLUP (String): Region rollup.</li>
  <li>OCC_CODE / NOC (String): Occupation code (NOC or agency-specific code).</li>
  <li>PERCENT (Numeric): Probability/share of programme NLS entering this occupation (0-1).</li>
  <li>SURVEY (String, optional): Source tag (e.g., "PTIB" for synthetic private-institution rows).</li>
</ul>

## Technical Requirements

R packages used (as required by the script):
- `tidyverse`, `DBI`, `RODBC`, `glue`, `assertthat`

## Methodology Overview

The workflow follows the Q_1 / Q_2 / Q_3 sequence implemented in R/07-occupation-projections.R. The summary below mirrors code blocks and business rules.

### Q_1 — Program-level graduate projections
- Combine graduate_projections with cohort_program_distributions.
- Exclude programs listed in exclusion lookups.
- Compute GRADS = GRADUATES * PERCENT to allocate projected graduates to program-level cohorts.
- Produce both LCIP4 and LCP2 rollups (LCP2 = first 2 digits of LCP4) and age-group rollups.

### Q_2 — Apply labour-supply distributions to compute NLS
- Join program-level GRADS to labour_supply_distribution at LCIP4+AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP to compute NLS:

  NLS = GRADS * NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY

- For program/age combinations missing LCIP4 labour-supply rows, apply fallbacks in order:
  1. labour_supply_distribution_no_tt (No trades/TTRAIN variable)
  2. Private-training (PTIB) proxy rows (CERT <-> DIPL substitutions where needed)
  3. LCP2 (2-digit CIP) proxy via t_lcp2_lcp4 mapping
- Each fallback computes NLS similarly; intermediate unions aggregate all NLS rows.
- Region and age group rollups preserved via join keys (CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE_ROLLUP, AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP).

### Q_3 — Map program NLS into occupations
- Join NLS rows to occupation_distributions (LCIP4 or LCIP2 level as appropriate).
- Compute occupational counts per cell:

  OCCSN = NLS * PERCENT

- Aggregate occupation counts by NOC/NOC grouping, age rollup, region, credential, and year.

### PTIB & Private Institution Handling
- Create synthetic PTIB labour-supply and occupation distributions by filtering public-survey tables and tagging SURVEY = "PTIB" with adjusted PSSM_CRED values; append to distribution tables so private institutions receive plausible shares.

### Quality indicators and reruns
- The script is designed to rerun the full pipeline to produce a QI measure of predictability for each NOC projection (repeating the Q_1..Q_3 sequence and comparing outcomes across runs).

## Key Outputs (data dictionary)

- NLS_Distributions (program-level): NLS by PSSM_CREDENTIAL, PSSM_CRED, AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP, YEAR, LCP4_CD/LCP2_CD, CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE_ROLLUP
  - NLS (numeric): New Labour Supply estimate = GRADS * NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY

- Occupation_Level_Counts: occupation-level counts (OCCSN) by the same dimensions + occupation code
  - OCCSN (numeric): expected number in occupation = NLS * PERCENT (occupation probability)

### Runtime Key Output Aliases (temporary)

These aliases are set at runtime and referenced by downstream processes and exports. They point to the principal final table q_5_noc_totals_by_year_and_bc_and_total when the corresponding run flags are enabled.

#### tmp_tbl_model
<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>Alias for: q_5_noc_totals_by_year_and_bc_and_total (when regular_run == TRUE)</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP_LABEL (String): Aggregated age-group label used for reporting (e.g., "20-24").</li>
  <li>NOC_LEVEL (Integer): Aggregation level (1..5) indicating NOC granularity.</li>
  <li>NOC (String): NOC code (5-digit, zero-padded where needed).</li>
  <li>ENGLISH_NAME (String): Human-readable occupation name for the NOC.</li>
  <li>CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE_ROLLUP (Integer): Region rollup code (e.g., 5900 for BC).</li>
  <li>Year columns (Numeric): One column per projection YEAR containing OCCSN totals for that NOC/age/region.</li>
  <li>Notes: Used for the standard model run outputs and further public/internal export workflows.</li>
</ul>

#### tmp_tbl_qi
<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>Alias for: q_5_noc_totals_by_year_and_bc_and_total (when qi_run == TRUE)</li>
  <li>Same schema as tmp_tbl_model.</li>
  <li>Notes: Used when quality-indicator calculations are enabled; downstream code expects this alias for QI-specific exports and diagnostics.</li>
</ul>

(Recommend adding explicit OUTPUT comments in the script near where these aliases are set to make them unambiguously discoverable by tooling.)

## Business Rules / Notes

- Exclusion lists (t_exclude_*) remove programs where Student Outcomes results are inappropriate for projections.
- Private training institutions are proxied into distributions because survey coverage differs; CERT/DIPL substitutions intentionally broaden matches and may inflate totals (documented in code).
- LCP2 proxies are used cautiously: certain medical programs are excluded from 2-digit proxying due to tight program-occupation links.
- All joins use exact keys; missing labour-supply rows drive the fallback logic to ensure complete coverage.

## Validation and Checks

- Totals are aggregated and compared by credential/age/year to the original graduate projections to ensure mass balance.
- Manual review lists are produced where automated proxying or substitutions are applied (e.g., PTIB, CERT/DIPL swaps).

## Implementation Caveats

- The script assumes required tables exist in the global environment or are accessible via DB queries.
- Some variable naming inconsistencies (noted in-code) may require upstream fixes (e.g., missing "I" in CIP2 names in certain tables).
